name: Tetrapeptide-15
summary: Endomorphin-2 (EM-2) is an endogenous opioid peptide and one of the two endomorphins. It has the amino acid sequence Tyr-Pro-Phe-Phe-NH2. It is a high affinity, highly selective agonist of the μ-opioid receptor, and along with endomorphin-1 (EM-1), has been proposed to be the actual endogenous ligand of this receptor (that is, rather than the endorphins).

pharmacology.text: It is a high affinity, highly selective agonist of the μ-opioid receptor, and along with endomorphin-1 (EM-1), has been proposed to be the actual endogenous ligand of this receptor (that is, rather than the endorphins).

uses.en: It is a natural opioid peptide studied in pain research. A modified form, acetyl tetrapeptide-15, is used in some skin-care products.
uses.zh: 它是一種天然的鴉片胜肽，用於疼痛研究。它的修飾形式乙醯基四胜肽-15則被用於部分保養品中。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种天然的鸦片胜肽，用于疼痛研究。它的修饰形式乙酰基四胜肽-15则被用于部分保养品中。

fact.en: Endomorphin-2 was discovered in 1997 and is just four amino acids long. It binds the mu opioid receptor very selectively, which led researchers to propose it as that receptor's true natural partner.
fact.zh: 腦內嗎啡肽2在1997年被發現，只由四個胺基酸組成。它與μ鴉片受體的結合具有很高的選擇性，因此研究者提出它才是這個受體真正的天然配對物質。
fact.zhHans: 脑内吗啡肽2在1997年被发现，只由四个胺基酸组成。它与μ鸦片受体的结合具有很高的选择性，因此研究者提出它才是这个受体真正的天然配对物质。
